keyPoints.en: 3R: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle (reduce is best). Bins: blue = paper, orange = plastic and metal, brown = glass.
keyPoints.bm: 3R: Kurangkan, Guna Semula, Kitar Semula (kurangkan terbaik). Tong: biru = kertas, jingga = plastik dan logam, coklat = kaca.

keyPoints.en: Saves resources and energy (e.g. aluminium), reduces landfill and pollution, creates jobs and income.
keyPoints.bm: Menjimatkan sumber dan tenaga (cth. aluminium), mengurangkan tapak pelupusan dan pencemaran, mewujudkan pekerjaan dan pendapatan.

keyPoints.en: National Recycling Day (11 November), separation at source, recycling centres, SWCorp, school and community campaigns.
keyPoints.bm: Hari Kitar Semula Kebangsaan (11 November), pengasingan sisa di punca, pusat kitar semula, SWCorp, kempen sekolah dan komuniti.

keyPoints.en: Japan: strict sorting. Germany: deposit-refund bottles. Sweden: waste-to-energy. Malaysia can learn from these.
keyPoints.bm: Jepun: pengasingan ketat. Jerman: deposit dan bayaran balik botol. Sweden: sisa kepada tenaga. Malaysia boleh belajar daripadanya.
